title: The occult, astrology and spiritual discernment
tagline: Understand why the Church warns against horoscopes, tarot, ouija and mediums, and respond with calm, not fear.
whyItMatters: Astrology, tarot and mediums are common and often treated as harmless fun. The Church asks Christians to trust God, to avoid seeking hidden knowledge from spirits, and to meet fear with prayer and the sacraments.

mindset.tip: Do not mock. Many people turn to these practices from grief, fear or loneliness, so begin with that need (Matthew 9:36).
Know what the Church actually says: divination and magic are contrary to trust in God (CCC 2115-2117).
Keep calm. The Church warns about real spiritual danger but does not want us to see demons everywhere.
Point to the better path: Providence, prayer and the sacraments, and ask a priest when something frightening has happened.
Do not try to deal with a serious case alone. In rare cases the bishop and an exorcist are involved, after medical and psychological help (CCC 1673).
